def is_palindrome(s):
    """
    Return True iff `s` is a palindrome, ignoring case and
    non-alphanumeric characters. An empty string (or a string
    containing no alphanumeric characters) is considered a
    palindrome.
    """
    if s is None:
        return False
    cleaned = [ch.lower() for ch in s if ch.isalnum()]
    return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]
